mission: Recover and complete the replayable typed Steward disposition bridge used by the Planner compiler, preserving immutable RETURNs and fail-closed scope-aware disposition semantics.
useful_delta: Recovered a stale GEN2 dependency without rewriting its prior evidence. The stale worker had already materialized the disposition ledger schema, validator, negative tests and fixture. This recovery re-read those exact GitHub blobs, reconstructed byte-exact local mirrors verified by Git blob SHA, executed the published test suite and CLI, and found no repair necessary.

machine_valid_disposition_schema.evidence: Schema pins the five allowed dispositions, explicit source hashes, source authority labels, visibility state and planning-only effect authority.

missing_disposition_fails_closed.evidence: Negative test deletes disposition and validator returns ok=false with a disposition-path error.

partial_scope_conflict_visible.evidence: Fixture projects one CONSUMED and one CONFLICTED scope from the same immutable RETURN while retaining a separate PENDING_UNREAD RETURN.

immutable_returns_not_rewritten.evidence: Validator rejects embedded return_payload fields and ledger stores only return_ref plus source_content_sha256 for source evidence.

test_execution.environment: isolated local byte-exact mirror reconstructed from GitHub fetch_file content; no repository network checkout

byte_identity.method: Git blob SHA-1 recomputation over local bytes matched GitHub blob SHA for all four tested artifacts

test_execution.verification_note: This is an executed local semantic test of exact published bytes, not repository CI and not Human Acceptance.

negative_knowledge: No artifact was promoted to Current, Human Accepted or Served.
No code repair was made because the exact published candidate already passed its tests.
This return completes only O-INTEGRATION-INGEST-BRIDGE-V1; O-GEN2-END-TO-END-CANARY-V1 still requires the separate O-METABOLIC-SPINE-BUILD-V1 return.
The local execution is not CI evidence.
remaining_boundary: GEN2 end-to-end canary remains dependency-blocked until O-METABOLIC-SPINE-BUILD-V1 has a durable qualifying RETURN. Recompute dynamic readiness from exact returns before claiming the successor.
